nodes.label: UTN Facultad Regional Concepción del Uruguay – Logo
nodes.description: Official logo of UTN (Universidad Tecnológica Nacional) Facultad Regional Concepción del Uruguay. Displays the UTN wordmark in bold sans-serif alongside the faculty's characteristic cross/asterisk symbol, with the full faculty name 'FACULTAD REGIONAL CONCEPCIÓN DEL URUGUAY' in black on white. Used as a member/partner institution logo on the landing page.
